candidates.detail: The six terrain entries each contribute direct and effective hours. The direct sum is divided by six; the effective sum is divided by five. SkillTooltip derives correlated hours as the effective aggregate minus direct aggregate and describes their sum as effective hours. For a positive finite effective sum S, S/5 is 20 percent above the six-entry mean S/6; the extra amount is presented as correlation. Both the accessible description and serialized skill tooltip feed the rank-bar markup, and the client tooltip reads those same serialized values. These are source-derived consequences; no HTML, browser or product execution was observed.
candidates.example: For the source-test-shaped input of 1000 direct forest hours and zero for the other five terrain skills, the one-pass 20-percent correlations yield 1000 effective forest hours and 200 for each other entry, sum 2000. The displayed aggregate is approximately 166.7 direct, 400.0 effective and 233.3 correlated hours; a six-entry mean would be approximately 166.7 direct, 333.3 effective and 166.7 correlated. This is arithmetic from inspected source, not a run of the source test, rendering or a product numerical probe.
candidates.safeguards: terrain_family_rank separately averages six individually capped ranks; the displayed aggregate-hour denominator is not used by that rank function or the leaf skill projections on this traced path. Do not claim inflated gameplay rank, stored training or gameplay impairment. The source test checks leaf strings for cross-habitat projection but does not assert the aggregate tooltip values; it was read, not run. The skills rail renders the table only when a skills view is supplied.
